::: {.lead}
Today you prepare a staff meeting with Microsoft Office, like in an
office. Each experiment has two parts. **Part A** is in Word and Outlook
(your university account). **Part B** is on a simulator of the interactive
lesson: on paper, scan its QR code; on the screen, click its link. After
each step, write your result in its box. At the end, copy your key results
into the table.
:::

## Before you start

- **You need:** a lab computer with Word and Outlook (or Microsoft 365 on
  the web at `office.com`), your university account and the start file.
- **No lab computer today?** Do Part B of each experiment on your phone.
- **Send only to your own address** in Part A.
- **Check:** the results are at the end of this worksheet. Look only after
  you try. On the interactive lesson, every step has a check that answers
  at once.

{{< start-files >}}

## Experiment 1 · The Office window and the ribbon

**The idea:** **Word** makes documents, **Excel** workbooks of cells (B3),
**PowerPoint** presentations of slides. All three have a **title bar** (the
file name), the **ribbon** and a **status bar** (the page, the zoom). The
ribbon has **tabs** (Home, Insert, Layout), each tab **groups** (Font,
Paragraph), each group **commands** (Bold): we write **Home › Font ›
Bold**. **File › New** shows **templates**: ready-made files with a design.

**Aim:** read the parts of the window, and find a command on the ribbon.

::: {.part}
**Part A · In the app (Word)**
:::

1. Open `agenda-start.docx` (click **Enable Editing** if you see it). Read
   the title bar at the top and the status bar at the bottom.

   {{< record "Title bar: … ; status bar: Page … of …" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   The title bar shows **agenda-start**. The status bar shows **Page 1 of
   1**.
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   Which part of the window shows the name of the file?

   - [x] the title bar

     Why: The title bar at the top shows the file name.

   - [ ] the status bar

     Why: The status bar shows the page and the zoom.

   - [ ] the ribbon

     Why: The ribbon has the commands.
   :::

2. Click in the first line and center it. Then click **File › New** and
   find a template for an invitation.

   {{< record "The way to Center: … › … › Center" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **Home › Paragraph › Center**. A template is a ready-made file with a
   design: you change only the text.
   :::

   ::: {.sort}
   Which tab has each command? Sort them.

   Home
   :   Center

       Why: A common command for a paragraph.

   :   Bold

       Why: Home › Font › Bold.

   Insert
   :   Table

       Why: You add a table.

   Layout
   :   Orientation

       Why: The setup of the whole page.
   :::

::: {.part}
**Part B · On the simulator** (no computer? do it on your phone)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/ribbon-finder.html" poster="sims/ribbon-finder.png" title="Ribbon Finder: tab, group, command" >}}

3. In **Ribbon Finder**, find the commands of the jobs. Where is Print?

   {{< record "Print is on" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   The **File** tab: commands for the whole file (Save, Print, Share) are
   there, not on Home.
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   Where is the command to check the spelling of a report?

   - [x] Review › Proofing › Spelling & Grammar

     Why: The Review tab checks a file.

   - [ ] Home › Font

     Why: The Font group changes how letters look.

   - [ ] File › Print

     Why: Print makes a paper copy.
   :::

## Experiment 2 · Save, a PDF, and one shared file

**The idea:** **Save** (Ctrl + S) keeps the same file; **Save As** makes a
new copy (a new name, place or **format**). `.docx` can change; **`.pdf`**
keeps its look. **AutoSave** works only for files in **OneDrive**. To work
together, keep **one** file in OneDrive and **Share** it with **Can edit**:
people edit it at the same time (**co-editing**) and add **comments**.

**Aim:** save the agenda in OneDrive and as a PDF, and share it to edit
together.

::: {.part}
**Part A · In the app (Word)**
:::

1. Click **File › Save As**, choose **OneDrive** and the name
   `staff-agenda`. Look at the **AutoSave** switch. Then click **File ›
   Save a Copy** (or Save As), choose the type **PDF** and save.

   {{< record "AutoSave is … ; the two files: … and …" lines=2 >}}

   ::: {.check}
   AutoSave is **On** (the file is in OneDrive). The two files:
   **staff-agenda.docx** (you can change it) and **staff-agenda.pdf** (for
   reading and printing).
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   Everybody must read the agenda, but nobody may change it. Which file do
   you send?

   - [x] staff-agenda.pdf

     Why: A PDF keeps its look, and people do not easily change it.

   - [ ] staff-agenda.docx

     Why: Anyone can change a Word file.

   - [ ] a template

     Why: A template is a start for a new file.
   :::

2. Click **Share**: choose **Specific people** and **Can edit** (do not
   send). Then select **10:00**, click **Review › New Comment**, type `Is
   10:00 OK?` and **Post**.

   {{< record "Who: … ; what: … ; the comment is on the … side" lines=2 >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **Specific people**, **Can edit**: only the colleagues get the link, and
   they can add points. The comment is on the **right** side, next to the
   text.
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   Omar and Lina must add their points to the agenda. Which settings?

   - [x] Specific people, Can edit

     Why: Only the two of them get the link, and they can change the file.

   - [ ] Anyone with the link, Can edit

     Why: The link can travel to strangers.

   - [ ] Specific people, Can view

     Why: With Can view they cannot add their points.
   :::

::: {.part}
**Part B · On the simulator** (no computer? do it on your phone)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/save-lab.html" poster="sims/save-lab.png" title="Save Lab: Save, Save As and AutoSave" >}}

3. In **Save Lab**, do Tasks 1 to 3. In which tasks is nothing lost?

   {{< record "Nothing is lost in Tasks …" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **Tasks 2 and 3**: you saved before the power cut, or AutoSave was on
   for a file in OneDrive.
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   A file is on the desktop of a lab computer. Does AutoSave work?

   - [x] no: press Ctrl + S often

     Why: AutoSave works only for files in OneDrive.

   - [ ] yes, always

     Why: Only for files in OneDrive.
   :::

## Experiment 3 · An e-mail and a meeting

**The idea:** an e-mail has **To** (the people who act), **Cc** (the
people who only need to know), a **subject** and an **attachment** (the
paperclip). **Reply** answers the sender, **Reply all** everyone,
**Forward** sends the e-mail and its file to a new person. A **meeting
invitation** from the calendar has a time, the attendees and an **online
meeting** link (Teams): they answer Accept, Tentative or Decline.

**Aim:** send the agenda by e-mail, and invite people to an online meeting.

::: {.part}
**Part A · In the app (Outlook)**
:::

1. **New mail** to your own address. Subject: `Agenda: staff meeting on
   Sunday`. **Attach** (the paperclip) `staff-agenda.pdf` and **Send**.
   Find it in the Inbox.

   {{< record "In the Inbox, the sign of a file is" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   A **paperclip** next to the e-mail.
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   A new colleague needs this e-mail with its file. What do you click?

   - [x] Forward

     Why: Forward sends the e-mail and its file to a new person.

   - [ ] Reply

     Why: Reply goes back to the sender, without the file.

   - [ ] Reply all

     Why: Reply all goes to the people already in the e-mail.
   :::

2. In the **Calendar**, click **New event**: `Staff meeting`, next Sunday,
   10:00 to 10:30. Turn on **Teams meeting**, invite your own address and
   **Send**. Open the event.

   {{< record "The event has a button to" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **Join**: the online meeting link. The attendees join from any place.
   :::

   ::: {.sort}
   Which answer does each attendee give? Sort them.

   Accept
   :   Omar will come.

       Why: Accept puts the meeting in his calendar.

   Tentative
   :   Lina may have a class at that time.

       Why: Tentative means maybe.

   Decline
   :   Sami is on holiday that day.

       Why: Decline says that he cannot come.
   :::

::: {.part}
**Part B · On the simulator** (no computer? do it on your phone)
:::

{{< sim file="sims/mail-lab.html" poster="sims/mail-lab.png" title="Mail Lab: To, Cc, subject and file" >}}

3. In **Mail Lab**, do Tasks 1 to 5. Task 1: who is in To and in Cc?

   {{< record "Task 1: To … ; Cc …" >}}

   ::: {.check}
   **To:** Omar and Lina (they come to the meeting). **Cc:** Mr Yousef (he
   only needs to know).
   :::

   ::: {.choice}
   In Task 1, Mr Yousef, the manager, only needs to know about the agenda.
   Where does he go?

   - [x] in Cc

     Why: Cc is for the people who only need to know.

   - [ ] in To

     Why: To is for the people who must act.

   - [ ] in the subject

     Why: The subject says what the e-mail is about.
   :::
